prospects.name: AlternativeTo
prospects.why_relevant: A software and web-app discovery directory. YashiPDF is a functioning browser-based utility suite; its English-language web app fits the application's listing process.
prospects.link_type: Unknown until an approved public listing is inspected; nofollow/sponsored status must be checked.
prospects.instructions: Create a personal account and verify its email. From the user menu choose Suggest new application and submit accurate platform, license, description, and tags. Standard review is free; the site separately offers optional paid priority review, which is not needed and must not be selected. Approval is not guaranteed and the review backlog may be long.
prospects.description: YashiPDF is a free web-based collection of PDF and image utilities, including image-format conversion, image compression and resizing, cropping, and image-to-PDF. It also provides practical guides for preparing files for common online tasks.

prospects.name: Ignlab Launch
prospects.why_relevant: A free directory for SaaS and web tools. It has a Developer Tools category and PDF and image-tools tags, which fit YashiPDF's browser-based file utilities.
prospects.link_type: Unknown until a listing is published and inspected; do not assume follow.
prospects.instructions: Use the public Submit your tool form. Enter the homepage (not an article URL), name, short tagline, accurate description, category, pricing, and optional maker details. The site says submissions are free and reviewed. The page displays an anti-abuse challenge; complete it manually if required, never automate or bypass it.
prospects.description: Free online PDF and image utilities for converting formats, compressing and resizing images, cropping photos, and creating PDFs. YashiPDF also publishes practical guides for common file tasks.

prospects.name: Product Hunt
prospects.why_relevant: A maker and early-adopter product launch community that accepts working web products. A launch is most relevant when the maker can participate and respond to feedback.
prospects.link_type: Unknown until a public product page is published and inspected; the launch guide describes a product URL but does not specify rel attributes.
prospects.instructions: Sign in with a personal maker account; use Submit > New Product. The official guide does not state a submission fee, so verify the current flow is no-cost before proceeding. Do not pay a hunter, buy promotion, solicit votes, or launch until the maker is ready to participate. The draft flow can be saved before launch.
prospects.description: YashiPDF is a free online collection of PDF and image tools for everyday file tasks: convert image formats, compress or resize photos, crop images, and create PDFs. It includes practical how-to guides alongside the tools.
